description: Activation and outcome cases for source-grounded offline courses.

evals.prompt: Make an offline interactive course teaching a newcomer how scripts/symlink_plugins.py plans changes. Write it to a new course directory.

outcome.description: Creates an accessible local learning resource grounded in inspected source.
assertions: The HTML has linked lessons, source paths and line ranges, and an exercise with answer feedback
The course requires no external network assets
The response identifies the output and distinguishes browser checks from static checks

evals.prompt: Make a browser course about this small repository, but the requested destination already contains files and the runtime behavior has not been tested.

outcome.description: Preserves existing output and reports evidence limitations.
assertions: Asks before overwriting or proposes an unused sibling destination
Distinguishes source evidence from unverified runtime behavior

evals.prompt: What does this five-line Python function return?

outcome.description: Answers the question without generating a course.
assertions: Does not create an HTML course
